sample_unit: case abstracts (randomly selected subset of 3678 PubMed OB/GYN case abstracts rated by two educators)

links.outcome: LLM extraction accuracy and hallucination rate versus expert ground truth
links.effect: 96.0% accuracy for primary diagnoses, 92.0% for core teaching points; overall hallucination incidence 3.0%
links.quote: The LLM demonstrated high precision in extracting objective clinical data, achieving a 96.0% accuracy rate for primary diagnoses and 92.0% for core teaching points.

unlisted_practices: Using a locally deployed open-weight LLM to automate extraction of structured case-based learning content from literature for medical education

screen.reason: Evaluates a locally deployed LLM's accuracy and hallucination rate when extracting medical education case-based learning content from PubMed abstracts, without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment intervention.
